experience.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant, Data Structures and Algorithms in C
bullets: Held weekly office hours and lab sessions for **100+ students**, explaining data structures, algorithms, and **C** programming.
Graded **19+** homework and lab assignments with consistent rubrics, and worked with the instructor to refine assignments.

experience.title: Machine Learning Intern
bullets: Built predictive classification models with **TensorFlow** and **Scikit-learn**, comparing **5+** algorithms to reach **85%** accuracy.
Engineered **20+** features in a **Pandas** and SQL pipeline, improving F1-score by **15%**.

projects.subtitle: A/B Testing Platform
bullets: Built an end-to-end **A/B testing** and causal inference platform over **10M+** simulated events, with **12** dbt models across 3 tiers.
Cut metric computation from **45s to 0.8s**, and added **CUPED** variance reduction of **30-45%** alongside Welch's t-test and sequential testing.
projects.reason: Experimentation platform that matches the posting's A/B testing focus.

projects.subtitle: Severity Classification
bullets: Built a binary severity classifier on **7.7M** US accident records across **49** states, reaching **ROC-AUC 0.818** with tuned **XGBoost**.
Handled an **80.5%/19.5%** class imbalance with **SMOTE**, and explained severity drivers with SHAP and a **Tableau** dashboard.

projects.subtitle: Hybrid Recommender
bullets: Built a hybrid recommender combining content-based and **collaborative filtering** via matrix factorization, reaching **Precision@10 of 0.64**.
Reached **Recall@10 of 0.76** and **MAP of 0.59**, with a modular pipeline and benchmarking suite for repeatable evaluation.
projects.reason: Recommender metrics for a consumer data role.

projects.subtitle: Prediction Dashboards
bullets: Trained **XGBoost** models on **500K+** data points from 10+ seasons, reaching **73%** podium accuracy and a **3.2s** lap-time MAE.
Engineered **70+** features with **Apache Spark**, and built a **Power BI** report alongside a React and D3.js dashboard.

projects.subtitle: Ensemble Regression
bullets: Built ensemble **regression** models (XGBoost, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting) on **50,000+** records, reaching **R squared of 0.82**.
Engineered **30+** features with cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning, holding RMSE to **$45,000**, and validated results in **R**.
projects.reason: Statistical modeling in Python and R.

fit_paragraph: Strong match for experimentation and modeling work; the posting's Looker requirement is the one real gap.
